Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the object corresponding to the source DVD remain identifiable as that DVD in the edited image?
node.criteria: Pass only if the edited object can be matched to the source DVD and remains identifiable as a DVD. Fail if the source DVD is absent or replaced by an unrelated object. Unknown if correspondence or DVD identity cannot be established.
node.binding: Compare the small rectangular DVD case near the center of the source image with candidate objects in the edited image, considering location and surrounding scene. Do not infer identity from a nearby white disc's shape alone; leave correspondence unresolved when the visual evidence is insufficient.

node_traces.evidence: The source DVD is the small rectangular case near the center. In the edited image, that case is no longer visible; two white discs appear, but their shapes alone do not establish which, if either, corresponds to the source DVD. The surrounding scene is similar, but correspondence and DVD identity cannot be established from the visual evidence.
